about: Slab looks: every fracturing floor and roof of the install's maps (custom geometry plan, M4a), each measured by tools/bake/slab_measure.py on its donor (`map`, `actor`: the placing to copy, at scale 1 where it has one) into the recipe tools/bake/frac_slab.py builds from (a look given as {mesh, measure, recipe}), with what a made slab lacks (`warnings`, plain words) and the twin check (`twin`: "ok", or what differs when the look is built at the donor's size and measured again; triangles a tile are told in the check but don't fail it). Pitched and thick roofs are made flat in their top's material (D13). `maps`: its placings by map. `setting`: its role and its top material's kind, by the material's name. lwrOnly: every map read is one Firaxis cooked (licensee 64; library.donors reads no other), so every donor is in a base-game package (Enemy Within, or its Slingshot content where the facts say so); the install offers no list of the files Long War Rebalance added, so no look is marked LWR-only (false for all). Written by `python -B tools/bake/slab_catalogue.py build`; the Build doesn't need it.
built: <game>: the maps it lists, 151 read (base maps and streams Firaxis cooked)
